description: Residents of Barnet, Ryegate and Waterford are invited to meet David Tucker at the Barnet Public Library147 Church Streeton April 15th at 6pm Discussion will focus on identifying early steps of the campaign and ways for community members to get involved. We look forward to seeing you there!
